title: Reference Re Secession of Quebec (1998)
summary: The Supreme Court of Canada clarified that secession would require constitutional amendment and negotiation, not unilateral declaration alone.
principle: Federalism, democracy, and constitutional amendment in national unity questions.

title: R v Oakes (1986)
summary: Landmark proportionality test for limits on Charter rights under section 1.
principle: Section 1 Oakes test for reasonable limits on rights.

title: Vriend v Alberta (1998)
summary: Reading sexual orientation into provincial human rights law to align with Charter equality values.
principle: Equality and inclusion under the Charter.

title: Carter v Canada (2015)
summary: Criminal prohibitions on physician-assisted dying were unconstitutional in defined circumstances.
principle: Liberty, autonomy, and section 7 life, liberty, and security of the person.

title: Alberta v Hutterian Brethren of Wilson Colony (2009)
summary: Balanced mandatory photo requirements for drivers' licences against religious freedom claims.
principle: Section 2(a) religious freedom and proportionate limits.

title: Retail, Wholesale and Department Store Union v Dolphin Delivery (1986)
summary: Early Charter-era guidance on application of Charter rights to private litigation.
principle: Horizontal effect and Charter application scope.

title: Little Sisters Book and Art Emporium v Canada (2000)
summary: Customs censorship of LGBTQ literature engaged freedom of expression and equality.
